variantMappingNotes: The 'hero' base maps to two distinct variants (hero-intro for the top intro, hero-banner for the closing full-bleed CTA). The 'cards' base maps to two distinct variants (cards-gallery for the captionless photo grid, cards-article for the linked article cards). Per-sequence blockName is authoritative.
